Power Rangers - Lightspeed Rescue.name: Power Rangers: Lightspeed Rescue
Power Rangers - Lightspeed Rescue.summary: The Nintendo 64 version features 3D action-based gameplay involving the Rangers, their vehicles, and Megazords. It supports 1 or 2 players simultaneously. Villains from the show, such as Diabolico, serve as antagonists; and the game features voice clips from the actual Power Rangers Lightspeed Rescue cast. The game is also compatible with the Nintendo Controller Pak for saving progress.
